trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach — a place, an act and a condition, and the venue is now named by a single post-launch source, stated plainly so you can weigh it. PowerPyx's trophy guide, illustrated with screenshots, identifies the spot as the Ocean View Rooftop Bar: go there, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar, which unlocks the trophy. GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still describes this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed, so this card presents the rooftop method as PowerPyx's account rather than settled fact — but it is a cheap test either way: one drink at one named bar. The old version's instinct survives in the specifics — the 'view' in the description was indeed doing work, and the answer to it was height: not a towel on the sand, not any beachside counter, but a rooftop over the water. If the martini at that bar does not land it, you have spent the price of a cocktail learning that the single source was wrong, and the fallback is the old sweep: try the next spot with a view along the same beach, highest first.
steps: Travel to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar; the trophy should unlock as the moment registers.
Fallback, if it does not: work along Ocean Beach's other spots with a view, highest first, ordering a cocktail at each — the description's three conditions (place, drink, view) are the checklist.
trophies.tip: Go up before you go along: every failed ground-level drink is tuition for the same lesson — in this description, 'with a view' means above the beach, not on it.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Venue and drink (Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini): PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, checked 20 November 2026. Note: GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still listed this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed; the method above is PowerPyx's, attributed as such. Method framing: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, 'in classic style' — and the classic style turns out to be one specific car, which is why this card's old any-showroom method would have failed forever. This update rests on a single named source, stated plainly so you can weigh it: PowerPyx's post-launch trophy guide, which illustrates the method with screenshots, reports that the trophy requires stealing the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and that it unlocks only from that car, not from any other — an Easter egg reference to the Banshee of GTA III. The car can only be taken after you obtain the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS: hack into the Banshee, drive forward and straight through the showroom window, and keep driving — the unlock is slightly delayed and pops after you have driven further away on the street. GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still describes this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed, which is why this card names its source in the text instead of presenting the method as settled everywhere: one detailed, illustrated, post-launch guide against another guide's not-yet. If you try it and it does not pop, the cost is one stolen car and some glass.
steps: Progress the story until you have the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — the car cannot be taken before that.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee inside it.
Hack into the Banshee with the Key Cloner and get in.
Drive forward, straight out through the showroom window, and keep driving away down the street; the slightly delayed trophy should pop as you leave the area.
trophies.tip: Car first, glass second: any other showroom car through any other window is just vandalism — the recipe is the blue Banshee, the south Vice City showroom, and a straight line out.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Specific-car method, Key Cloner requirement and delayed unlock: PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, checked 20 November 2026. Note: GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still listed this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed; the method above is PowerPyx's, attributed as such. Method framing: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Do the thing at the named place — except the thing is not bowling, and this card has been rewritten because its original reading of 'follow-through' was wrong. Both post-launch sources below describe the same real trigger: the Kolt & Associates alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, and it is a gang operation, not a leisure venue. The trophy is for stealing all three key valuables there: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs — so buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation before you go. The alley is first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops once you lose the police after the robbery, not at the moment you pick up the third item, and the sources are clear on the two facts that make it forgiving: you do not need all three valuables in one visit, and the trophy is not missable — if you took two during the optional mission, wait for the robbery icon to respawn (it takes a long time) and go back for the third. Killing the enemies inside is not required.
steps: Before going, buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation — the safe cannot be opened without them.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (the Kolt & Associates alley), first marked during Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling.

Take the three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs.
Escape and lose the police; the trophy unlocks once you are clear, not at the third pickup.
If you missed one valuable, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and return for it — the three do not have to happen in a single visit.
trophies.tip: Nobody here wants you to bowl: read gold icons, not lane numbers — the three valuables are the game, and the pins are set dressing for a robbery.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Kingpin Bowling identity, the three valuables and their locations, sticky-bomb safe, escape condition and not-missable status: PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, and GTABase, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List, both checked 20 November 2026. Method: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The vaguest wording on the list — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and the answer, now reported by both post-launch sources below, is a pun hiding a stat: mass means muscle. PowerPyx and GTABase agree that this trophy unlocks when both characters, Jason and Lucia, have maximum Strength at the same time. 'Personal best' is the gym joke; 'partnership' is the requirement that both of them, not one, are at the cap. You can check either character's Strength via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select the character > Strength. Training only opens up after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters, and the efficient method is the one both sources describe: always work out together. Call your partner along (hold Right on the D-pad, press Triangle), buy a membership at a fitness club — they are all over Vice City and filterable under Map > Activities — and train: while you actively work out with one character, the other completes their training too, so the pair progress together instead of in two separate grinds. After the story you can also train at home. The card keeps its spoiler shield — the official description is story-adjacent by design — but it has left the watch list: the trigger is a grind with a progress bar, not a moment you can walk past.
steps: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break so both characters are available and switchable.
Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, press Triangle) and go together to a fitness club — filter Map > Activities to find one — and buy a membership.
Work out with one character while your partner trains alongside; check both Strength bars afterwards via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, and repeat sessions until the first character caps.
Keep training together until the second character also reaches maximum Strength — the trophy needs both at the cap at the same time, and unlocks when the second one gets there.
After the story, home workouts are an alternative venue if a club routine has gone stale.
trophies.tip: Train as a pair or pay twice: solo sessions raise one bar, joint sessions raise both — the partnership in the description is the method, not the flavour.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Maximum-Strength-for-both trigger, Coffee Break start point, partner training method and Strength menu path: PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, and GTABase, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List, both checked 20 November 2026. Method: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — and unusually for this corner of the list, there is a number to hold onto: the starter data notes that PlayStation tracks a count for this trophy, up to 500. Read plainly, the game counts decisions you make — dialogue choices, mission choices, judgement calls — and the trophy pays at the tracked total. You cannot grind what you cannot identify, so the method is exposure: never skip an offered choice, take the optional conversations and decision points other players rush past, and check the tracked progress on your PlayStation trophy card to confirm the count is moving with the choices you think it is.
steps: Take every dialogue and mission choice the game offers rather than letting defaults decide.
Check the trophy's tracked progress on PlayStation periodically to confirm choices are registering.
The trophy unlocks when the tracked count reaches its total.
trophies.tip: A tracked count is a gift — verify early that your choices move it, and you will never reach the endgame wondering if you chose enough.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the tracked count of 500 comes from the kit's starter data for this list. Method: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed at it on the second try — that is the plain reading of 'second time's the charm', and it is all the official text gives. This card stays on the watch list, and a fresh check on 20 November 2026 says it should: PowerPyx's post-launch trophy guide lists this trophy as currently unknown, and GTABase's trophy list likewise says its exact steps are not confirmed yet. PowerPyx does record one unconfirmed lead, labelled here exactly as they label it — a belief, not a method: the trophy is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Vice City's Little Cuba, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner. Treat that lead the way this guide treats all unconfirmed triggers: if you are passing that store anyway, a save-first experiment costs little, but do not build a session around it. The standing method below is unchanged, because it remains the only approach the official wording itself supports: whenever the game gives you a genuine fail state with an immediate retry — a race, a challenge, a mission check — take the retry seriously rather than reloading to erase the failure.
steps: Do not reload away honest failures in retryable activities — retry them in place.
When a retry succeeds, watch for the trophy; note the activity if it pops.
If you suspect a specific story moment is the trigger, test it from a spare save: fail once deliberately, succeed on the retry.

Optional, unconfirmed lead only: if you pass the Prologue's Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, you may test a save-first robbery there — PowerPyx records a belief, not a confirmation, that the trophy involves it.
trophies.tip: Perfectionist habits hide this trophy — the reload-before-anyone-saw reflex is exactly what 'second time' trophies punish.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Still-unknown status and the unconfirmed Payday Loans lead: PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, and GTABase, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List, both checked 20 November 2026. The retry method is this guide's own, offered as method, not fact.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — and the strange thing now has a name, a place and a time of night, on a single named source's evidence, stated plainly so you can weigh it. PowerPyx's post-launch trophy guide, illustrated with screenshots, identifies this trophy as the UFO Easter egg: at the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and you must come solo. The event is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, and if it is not there, drive away and come back. If the car is there, follow the path beside it into the woods and you will see the UFO — a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it, and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside, which unlocks the trophy. GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still described this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed, which is why this card attributes the method to PowerPyx in the text rather than presenting it as settled everywhere. The card keeps its spoiler shield — the event is a surprise by design — but leaves the watch list on the strength of that one detailed, illustrated account: a random spawn you can re-attempt any night is not a moment you can miss.
steps: Go solo, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return — the spawn is random, so repeat visits are the method, not a failure.
When the car is there, follow the path beside it into the woods toward the bright blue light in the sky and approach the UFO.
When it drops the abducted woman, talk to her, offer to help, and escort her back to her car at the roadside; the trophy unlocks as the encounter completes.
trophies.tip: Solo, after 2AM, and patient about the spawn: two of those are conditions and the third is the price — if the roadside is empty, the correct move is a loop around the block, not a new theory.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. UFO encounter, location, time, solo condition and escort steps: PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, checked 20 November 2026. Note: GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still listed this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed; the method above is PowerPyx's, attributed as such. Method framing: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — and this card's lone-pedestrian version has been replaced, because a single named post-launch source gives the trophy a vehicle, a count and a clock that the old reading missed entirely. PowerPyx's trophy guide states it directly: ride any bike and kick ten pedestrians, with the Square button, within sixty seconds, in crowded areas such as Vice City or Ocean Beach. That reframes everything about the setup. The vehicle is a bike, not a car; the attack is the rider's kick, not a swung weapon; and the feat is a streak — ten connected kicks inside one minute — which is why the source sends you to crowds instead of this card's old quiet road: a lone target every twenty seconds cannot feed a sixty-second count of ten. GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still described this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed, so the method above is PowerPyx's, attributed as such. The old card's one surviving insight is the speed window: ride at a pace where the kick, not the bike, does the knocking down — running a pedestrian over is a different act and does not feed the streak.
steps: Take any bike to a crowded area — Vice City or Ocean Beach, per the source below — where pedestrians come in streams, not singles.
Ride through the crowd at a controlled speed and kick pedestrians with Square as you pass, keeping each kick a kick: if the bike itself flattens them, slow down.
Chain ten kicks within sixty seconds; if the minute lapses first, circle back into the crowd and start a fresh streak rather than chasing stragglers.
The trophy unlocks when the tenth kick lands inside the window.
trophies.tip: Density is the difficulty setting: ten kicks in a minute is easy in a crowd and impossible on a quiet road — pick the pavement with the people, and let the streak come to you.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Bike, kick input, ten-in-sixty-seconds count and crowded-area advice: PowerPyx, GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, checked 20 November 2026. Note: GTABase's trophy list, checked the same day, still listed this trophy's exact steps as unconfirmed; the method above is PowerPyx's, attributed as such. Method framing: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a quarter of a million dollars of marked bills through your contacts. The amount and the mechanism are both in the official text: marked bills come from robberies and jobs, contacts clean them, and the counter only moves when you actually run bills through that process. The method is a habit, not an event — never sit on marked bills. After every robbery, heist or job that pays in marked money, route it through a contact before you spend your attention elsewhere, and the total accrues across the whole playthrough.
steps: Whenever a job leaves you holding marked bills, take them to a contact for laundering promptly.
Check your running total occasionally so you know your pace.
The trophy unlocks when the laundered total reaches $250,000.
trophies.tip: Money left unlaundered is progress left uncounted — build the contact visit into your post-robbery routine, right after losing the heat.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade and the amount of $250,000), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Method: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend one hundred thousand dollars across all shops — cumulative, and across the shop system as a whole rather than in one place. Ordinary play gets you much of the way if you actually buy things: vehicles' upkeep, weapons, ammunition, clothing and services all count as shop spending, while property purchases have their own trophy and should not be relied on here. If you reach the endgame short of the total, the honest finisher is to buy useful stock — ammunition and gear you will genuinely use — rather than burning cash on waste.
steps: Buy what you need from shops as you play instead of hoarding cash.
Keep a rough sense of your spending pace against the $100,000 target.
If you finish the story short, top up with useful purchases; the trophy unlocks at the total.
trophies.tip: Hoarders finish this trophy last — the game rewards you here for participating in its economy, not for admiring your bank balance.
trophies.source: Source: official PlayStation 5 trophy list (name, description, grade and the amount of $100,000), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Method: this guide's own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game — eight garages, per the starter data. This is a money trophy wearing a property trophy's clothes: the only real requirement is having the cash, eight times over. That is why the roadmap puts it last among the money cards, when story and robbery income has peaked. Buy them in any order, cheapest first if cash is tight, and do not sell yourself short mid-run by buying early and starving the crime stop of getaway cars and equipment.
steps: Build your balance through the story and the crime stop first.
Buy garages as funds allow, cheapest first if you need to sequence them.
The trophy unlocks when the eighth garage is purchased.
trophies.tip: Garages are a victory lap, not an investment strategy — if buying one would leave you broke, earn first and buy at the end.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — and the registration desk is a place, not a menu, which is the detail this card originally missed. Both post-launch sources below describe the same system: the Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after a Chapter 2 mission for Moses, and registering a vehicle means driving a stolen vehicle to Moses at his garage in Port Gellhorn and choosing Respray and then Register there. Two constraints shape the order of work. First, space: each registration needs a free garage spot, so this card depends on Little Boxes — buy garages to make room, and PowerPyx states the dependency outright. Second, eligibility and cost: at first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, vehicles with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray, and every registration costs money, so cheap low-end cars and bikes are the sensible feedstock. Registering a vehicle also makes it deliverable to you wherever you are, which is the system's real prize — the trophy is ten uses of a service you will keep using. The pairing with Whip It Good survives, with a correction: scan unfamiliar vehicles with WAiNK for discovery, and register the cheap ones you actually steal for this count.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 Moses mission that installs the Scooter Bros app and unlocks Moses himself.
Make room first: own enough garage space for the vehicles you plan to register (see Little Boxes), because a registration without a free spot goes nowhere.
Steal a cheap car or bike — before Chapter 3, one without a tracker — and drive it to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn.
In the garage, choose Respray and then Register, and pay the registration cost.
Repeat with nine more vehicles; from Chapter 3, tracked vehicles can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray instead. The trophy unlocks at the tenth registration.
trophies.tip: Feed it cheap metal: the trophy counts registrations, not value — ten bikes and runabouts cost a fraction of ten sports cars and occupy the same slots.
